about_the_game:
Lightrix is a sleek, minimalist puzzle game about mixing colored light to solve a glowing grid of tiles. By adjusting and combining light sources, players bring each grid into balance through calm, logical problem-solving.

The full game features 30 handcrafted puzzles that gradually introduce new constraints and interactions, alongside an endless mode designed for relaxed, open-ended play.

With clean visual design, responsive controls, and optional day and night palettes, Lightrix offers a focused single-player experience built around clarity, rhythm, and satisfying solutions. 

Features:

  • 10 handcrafted puzzle levels with increasing complexity

  • Endless mode for relaxed, infinite play

  • Clean, minimalist sci-fi presentation

  • Optional day and night visual modes

  • Intuitive color-mixing puzzle mechanics

  • Designed for both short sessions and extended play
